text: Kettle. Do you mind if I use the kettle?
Cupboard. The mugs are in the cupboard above the sink.
Leftovers. There are leftovers from last night in the fridge.
Charger. Would you mind lending me a charger?
Password. Sorry to bother you, what is the wifi password?
Towel. There is a clean towel on your bed.
Settle in. It takes about a week to settle in.
Bother. Sorry to bother you, but where are the glasses?
Do you mind if I use the kettle? No, not at all.
Do you mind if I use your charger?
Would you mind showing me?
No, not at all. Go ahead.
Morning. Sorry, I have been awake since four. And my phone died on the plane.
Morning, love. Four o'clock is normal for day one. Did you find the towel Dave left you? There is a charger by the toaster.
I found it, thank you. Do you mind if I use the kettle? I do not want to break anything on my first morning.
Not at all, go ahead. The black one, not the silver one. Mugs are in the cupboard above the sink.
And would you mind giving me the wifi password? My mum is waiting for a message.
It is on the note on the fridge. Capital B, then the dog and the year. Tell her you arrived in one piece.
I will. Sorry to bother you again — do you mind if I have some of the leftovers? Dave said in his message...
Renato. This is your kitchen for six months. You never have to ask me about food. Not once.
Okay. One more, and then I stop. Would you mind showing me how the shower works? I pressed three buttons and nothing happened.
Now that one you do have to ask. Come on. And stop apologising — you will settle in faster if you just ask.
Do you mind if I use the kettle?
Would you mind showing me how this works?
Sorry to bother you. What is the wifi password?
Do you mind if I have some of the leftovers?

Morning Renato, it is Dave. I have already left for work, sorry about that, I start at six. Bev is in the shower, so help yourself to breakfast, mate. The bread is in the cupboard above the kettle and there are leftovers from last night in the fridge. Eat them, honestly, nobody else is going to. The wifi is written on the note on the fridge. Capital B at the start, then the dog and the year we got him. One thing. Do not use the small silver kettle on the shelf, that one is broken and it trips the whole house. Use the black one. And if you cannot find something, do not stand there being polite about it for twenty minutes. Just ask Bev. She does not bite. See you tonight.

Hi love, it is Bev. I am at work so this is quicker than typing. Two things. Dinner is at six thirty tonight, not seven, because Millie has training. If you are still at the beach at six, send me a message and I will keep yours warm. Second thing, the laundry. Do not do what the last student did and wash one shirt on a Sunday night. Put your things in the basket by the door and I will run it with ours on Wednesday. And one more. This morning you stood in that kitchen for ten minutes looking at the cupboards. Renato. Next time just ask. Would you mind showing me where the mugs are. That is a whole sentence and it costs you nothing. Right, I have to go. Six thirty.
